vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: scanwow-sync
Version: 1.1.0

The skill provides a utility to sync OCR text from the ScanWow iOS app to a local workspace via a webhook. The included Python script (save_scans.py) uses standard libraries, implements Bearer token authentication, binds to localhost for safety, and includes basic path traversal sanitization for saved files.
